name: Lechtal Camping Vorderhornbach
beschreibung: The campsite **Lechtal Camping Vorderhornbach** is located in the **Naturpark Lechtal** in the town of the same name, Vorderhornbach. The surroundings are characterized by the proximity to the wild course of the **Lech** and the mountain ranges of the **Lechtaler Alpen**. The facilities include both **parceled pitches** for motorhomes and caravans as well as meadow areas for **tents**. A **modern sanitary building** as well as a **bread roll service** and a **playground** are available. Due to its **quiet and family-friendly** atmosphere, the site is especially appreciated by **nature vacationers**, hikers and **cyclists**. The directly adjacent **Hornbergbahn** offers quick access to the Hahnenkamm hiking and skiing area. The campsite serves as a starting point for tours on the **Lechweg** or the regional mountain bike routes. Overall, it provides a base for activities throughout the entire **Außerfern**.
